subject: Fix strike resolution one frame early (f19137) + side-step misattribution
description: From 1bf80b6f7's re-diagnosis: at schema14/linux3/P003/Savegame_010/replay-007, Rust resolves the sword STRIKE (2x SwordDamageProtection + MeleeProvoke) at f19137 where the Original resolves at f19138 — both engines apply damage synchronously at launch, so this is a MOTION_DONE/sweep-seed timing skew (the strike animation completes a frame early) — motion_state-family timing, NOT melee dispatch. ALSO: the largest "SwordDamageProtection" sub-cluster (8 traces, linux2/P002/Savegame_003 family) is misattributed — the real extra draw is a SECOND CombatObserveSideStep (Original 1x, Rust 2x) — route to a side-step cadence investigation (kin of the aba2a0406 battle-predecision area).
